name: bld_center_eq_bot_of_card_prime_mul_prime
statement: (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hnc : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) : Subgroup.center G = ⊥
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hnc : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a), Subgroup.center G = ⊥
informal: Uses Mathlib2.alg_center_index_not_prime: |Z| divides p*q; |Z| = p or q gives prime index, contradicting the library theorem, and |Z| = p*q contradicts non-commutativity, so |Z| = 1.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p * q → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → Subgroup.center G = ⊥
